Identity.Name: Pset_StingLightningProtection
Identity.Definition: STING lightning protection system (LPS) design, inspection and zoning data per BS EN 62305, written by the LPS commands. IFC defines no lightning-protection property set (DSCH-38).

Governance.StandardsBasis: BS EN 62305-1/-2/-3/-4:2011 (LPS class, risk assessment, rolling sphere, separation distance, LPZ); BS EN IEC 61643 (SPD types)

Property.name: LightningProtectionClass
Property.Definition: LPS class per BS EN 62305 (I / II / III / IV). STING parameter ELC_LPS_CLASS_TXT. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_LightningProtector.LightningProtectionClass, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).
